description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Sri Lanka Deposit Insurance and Liquidity Support Scheme Regulations
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations issued by the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under the Monetary Law Act. It establishes the Sri Lanka Deposit Insurance and Liquidity Support Scheme, outlining regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments for banking and financial institutions. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for the financial sector.
